R. 1.">61</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a king of Kerala, son of Sudhārmika. [He was born under the Mūla asterism and his left foot had a redundant toe; for this his father was killed by his enemies, and the boy was left an orphan in a state of destitution. After much exertion he was restored to his kingdom. He became a friend of Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna when they came to the South in the course of their wanderings with the sacrificial horse.] ({@-सम्@}) silver.
